dictionary.title: Factory reset
dictionary.description: Erase everything and start over from the initial setup, as if Nuxiva had just been installed, with final proof that everything was deleted
dictionary.warning_body: People, faces, voiceprints, memory, linked accounts, settings, logs and keys will be permanently deleted. When finished, the system restarts from the first-run setup wizard. Software and already downloaded models stay installed.
dictionary.inventory_empty: There is no data to erase
dictionary.domain_people_hint: Registry, faces, voiceprints, listening log and learning
dictionary.domain_memory_hint: Memories, study, skills, habits and learned models
dictionary.domain_accounts_hint: Vault, Google, Telegram, tokens, VPN and certificates
dictionary.domain_home_hint: Cameras, rooms, printers, sensors and scenes
dictionary.domain_automations_hint: Routines, flows, schedules, projects and widgets
dictionary.domain_media_hint: Music library, voices, documents and presentations
dictionary.domain_configuration_hint: Settings, assistant name, session keys and secrets
dictionary.option_shares: Also erase files in shared folders
dictionary.keeps_note: Always kept: operating system, Nuxiva software, downloaded models and system accounts (the sign-in password is the computer's).
dictionary.backup_hint: You can create and download an archive of the current data to keep elsewhere before erasing.
dictionary.backup_plain_note: The archive is not encrypted: store it carefully or delete it after use.
dictionary.identity_body: To protect the system, re-enter your administrator account password.
dictionary.confirm_body: Type the code below exactly. The button unlocks after a short mandatory wait. The code is single-use and expires.
dictionary.understood: I understand that all data will be erased forever and this cannot be undone.
dictionary.running_working: Erasing data and verifying the result…
dictionary.running_down: The system is restarting: this is normal, please wait.
dictionary.running_hint: Do not power off the device. When done you will need to sign in again and the display will show the initial setup.
dictionary.check_leftovers: No data left in Nuxiva folders
dictionary.check_canaries: {{n}} sensitive control files no longer exist
dictionary.check_open: No process still holds deleted data open
dictionary.check_open_n: {{n}} deleted files still held open by a process: restart the device
dictionary.check_secrets: Keys and secrets regenerated ({{rotated}}), settings removed ({{removed}})
dictionary.report_ssd_note: On solid-state drives overwriting cannot be guaranteed at the physical level: for absolute erasure use an encrypted disk or reset the medium.
dictionary.report_next: Open the display or sign in again to complete the initial setup.
dictionary.report_signed_out: The reset finished and your session was closed for safety. Sign in again: the last report stays in this app.
dictionary.err_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts: wait a few minutes.
dictionary.err_system_busy: The system is busy with another operation: try again later.
dictionary.err_challenge_invalid: The code is no longer valid: start the check again.
dictionary.err_challenge_too_early: Wait for the countdown to finish.
dictionary.err_challenge_options_changed: The options changed: start the check again.
dictionary.err_phrase_mismatch: The code you typed does not match.
